content.short: Cronos is the leading EVM-compatible layer 1 blockchain network built on the Cosmos SDK.
content.description: Cronos is an EVM-compatible layer 1 blockchain built on the Cosmos SDK, backed by Crypto.com, Crypto.org, and a broad ecosystem of more than 400 app developers and partners. Its mission is to make it easy and safe for the next billion crypto users to adopt Web3, with a strong emphasis on DeFi and GameFi. Cronos seeks to simplify onboarding, deliver secure on-chain experiences, and enable scalable, interoperable applications across the fast-growing Web3 stack.
content.meta: Cronos is a leading EVM-compatible layer 1 blockchain network built on the Cosmos SDK. Discover Cronos and other Blockchains on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: What a Margin Call Is
resources.tldr: The moment the platform tells you a leveraged position has lost too much and you must add funds or it closes the position for you.

resources.title: Managing Risk Before It Manages You
resources.tldr: Every trade carries risk; the question is how much you can lose. The traders who last are the ones who decide that in advance.

resources.title: What Buying Power Really Means
resources.tldr: Deposit $100 at ten times leverage and you can trade $1,000 — but profit and loss are both calculated on the full amount.
